verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail is a SaaS virtual-mailbox platform with a public API, so agent-oriented docs or an llms.txt file are a fair thing for buyers to ask about. The probes found nothing: llms.txt returns HTTP 404, the markdown version of the developer docs returns 404, and every OpenAPI/Swagger candidate path returns 404. No other first-party evidence describes agent-oriented documentation.
